spots.name: Izembek NWR
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 157 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L1120073.

spots.name: Cold Bay
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 141 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L4991120.

spots.name: Rescue Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: FAA
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented.

spots.name: Haanĝux̂ Cold Bay Hot Springs
spots.tip: Steam reads best in cold air at first light. Check access rules; many springs are on private or tribal land.

spots.name: USFW Gazebo
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Kaslokan Point
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.
